collection.title: Renault Thalia 2008 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Renault Thalia 2008 Onwards requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 16" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Bayonet arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
